versions.text: Protective devices in circuits essential to safety in flight shall be so located and identified that fuses may be replaced or circuit breakers reset readily in flight,

If the ability to reset a cireuit breaker or to replace a fuse is essential to safety in flight, such circuit breaker or fuse shall be so located and identified that it can be readily reset or replaced in flight. 45. By amending § 3.693 to read as follows:
